persona: Shopify theme developer at a D2C agency
resumeText:
Sneha Patel | Ahmedabad | sneha.patel@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Wrote vanilla JavaScript for cart drawers, product filters and variant pickers.
- Converted Figma designs into responsive HTML and CSS sections with Tailwind.
- Improved mobile Lighthouse scores from 38 to 81 by lazy-loading images and trimming apps.
- Manage theme code in GitHub with a branch for each client store.

Junior Web Designer, Sabarmati Pixels, Ahmedabad (2020 - 2022)
- Designed landing pages and banners for local retailers.

SKILLS
Shopify, Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, Klaviyo

EDUCATION
BCA, Gujarat University, 2020
